modalities.evidence: Functional MRI consisted of three runs

output.population: Pediatric sample with and without anxiety disorders, ages 8.1–18 (N = 84 before exclusion); data shared only for participants who consented.
output.summary: Pediatric study linking subjective anxiety to brain function: resting-state and movie-watching fMRI with an anxiogenic animated stimulus, plus demographics, anxiety symptom measures, post-scan interviews and natural language processing derivatives.
